display.purpose: Page titles, section headers, modal/collapsible titles — mixed case, weight-based, never blanket uppercase.

body.purpose: All prose and form values, 14px/1.55, capped at 65-75ch.

data.purpose: Every data line — dates, meta, counts, the match-marker word — set in the mono stack, middot-separated.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The one soft shadow in the system. Overlays only (modal, dropdown/add-section menu, toast) — no resting in-content surface reuses it.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus/border-color transition on buttons, inputs, rows, links.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entrance (opacity + translateY(8px)). Cut to an instant fade under prefers-reduced-motion, alongside every other transition in the app.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default/submit action — terracotta fill. Spent on every real instance (once per row in a list of identical actions, e.g. Accept on every job suggestion), never capped at one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; background: var(--accent, #BC4A26); color: var(--accent-ink, #FFFFFF); transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #A53E1E); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-hover, #A53E1E) 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #BC4A26); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #BC4A26) 45%, var(--board, #D9E0DA)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline-outlined, transparent fill — the non-primary action beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1E332D); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 17px; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, #E3E8E4); border-color: var(--ink, #1E332D); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #BC4A26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Deep-red fill — a distinct hue from terracotta so a destructive action is never misread as the primary one (Reject beside Accept).
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; background: var(--danger, #8F2410); color: #fff; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #8F2410) 85%, black); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--danger, #8F2410); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Listing Board
components.description: A list is one tonal board split by hairlines, never a grid of bordered cards. Meta is a mono middot line, not chips; match is a square marker + a plain pine word.
components.html:
Data Scientist
GhentHybridDeadline 12 Aug
MATCH
ML Engineer
BrusselsRemote
components.css: .ds-board { background: var(--board, #D9E0DA); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); border-radius: 22px; overflow: hidden; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-board-row { padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); } .ds-board-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-row-title { color: var(--heading, #14261F); font-weight: 700; } .ds-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; margin-top: 8px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #3A4B43); } .ds-meta > span:not(:last-child)::after { content: '\00b7'; margin-left: 10px; color: var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); } .ds-meta-deadline { color: var(--accent-text, #8D3317); font-weight: 600; } .ds-match { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mark, #1F5A44); } .ds-match-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--mark, #1F5A44); }

components.name: Language Badge
components.description: Reserved for genuine categorical labels (a language level, a section's destination) — never used to restate a row's own fields, which stay plain mono text.
components.css: .ds-badge-lang { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1E332D); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A hairline-outlined pill row (radiogroup or toggle) — no gaps between options, hairline dividers instead. The selected option fills to terracotta with white text: the same 'current selection' signal as the engine/model pickers.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); border-radius: 999px; width: fit-content; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg button { padding: 7px 16px; background: transparent; border: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink, #1E332D); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:last-child { border-right: none; } .ds-seg button:hover:not([aria-checked='true']) { background: var(--surface, #E3E8E4); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #BC4A26); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background: var(--accent, #BC4A26); color: var(--accent-ink, #FFFFFF); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Pill single-line input, surface fill, hairline border. Padding clears the pill's own end-caps so text reads centred, not shoved against the curve.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(30,51,45,0.16)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 20px; width: 100%; background: var(--surface, #E3E8E4); color: var(--ink, #1E332D); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #BC4A26); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #BC4A26); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #3A4B43); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: A full 1px perimeter border carries the success/error/info signal — never a left colour stripe, the single most recognisable AI-slop tell. Dark heading fill, one soft float shadow (the only surface allowed to use it besides modals/menus).
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--heading, #14261F); color: var(--surface, #E3E8E4); border-radius: 22px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(20, 38, 31, 0.28); border: 1px solid var(--mark, #1F5A44); } .ds-toast-close { background: none; border: none; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface, #E3E8E4) 65%, transparent); padding: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast-close:hover { color: var(--surface, #E3E8E4); } .ds-toast-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--surface, #E3E8E4); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
MyJobCoach owns a colour instead of hiding in neutral. The whole app lives in one drenched, lighter colour world — a de-yellowed sage — rather than a light sheet floating on a contrasting wall. There is no cream and no dark wall: the ground is sage (--ground), the sidebar is a tonal step of that same ground, and content sits directly on it. Depth comes from tone, not shadow; a list is one tonal board split by hairlines, not a grid of bordered cards; meta and status are read as text, not stamped into pill badges. One warm terracotta accent carries every real signal moment.

That calm is structural. MyJobCoach's brand personality is calm, trustworthy, reassuring — job hunting is stressful enough — so the confidence lives in the drenched ground and the rounded, roomy form, while colour, motion, and copy stay purposeful rather than loud. Terracotta is warm by hue and, since 2026-07-22, spent generously wherever it means something: the primary/submit action (every occurrence, not just one per screen), the current selection, the deadline signal, and a small wayfinding touch (the active nav item — its label and icon — and the wordmark). It still never marks decoration or a merely-repeated element with no state behind it. This explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard (soft-shadowed cards, blue-gradient chrome, pastel status pills), corporate job-board chrome (LinkedIn/Indeed dense blue, stock-photo emptiness), and the AI-assistant chat-bot look (bubbles, glowing orbs, sparkle iconography) — the AI in this app does quiet background work, it never performs as a character. "Not generic" is earned by execution — the mono data voice on every field, tonal-only depth, and a purposeful (not decorative) accent — not by asserting it, and not by the absence of radius or depth.
keyCharacteristics: One drenched sage ground at three tonal values (ground/board/surface); no cream, no dark shell wall
Depth is tonal + hairline; no resting drop-shadow, no side-stripe accent, no cards
Listings are one tonal board split by hairlines
Meta/status are text (mono line, coloured marker/deadline), not pill badges
Rounded, roomy: pill controls, round panels/frame, generous spacing
System-sans body paired with a mono data voice for every data line; mixed-case, weight-based headings — no blanket uppercase
One terracotta accent, spent on every real action/selection/deadline signal — not on decoration, and not capped at one occurrence per screen

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Every hairline in the system is --line (color-mix(--ink 16%, transparent)) — a low-contrast ink line, never a separate gray token and never a coloured side-stripe.

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is not decoration and never marks two competing things in the same spot — but it is not capped at one occurrence per screen either. It marks: the default/submit action (every instance, including once per row in a list of identical actions), the current selection (segmented controls, engine/model pickers — accent fill, not ink), and the deadline signal. It does not mark decoration, categorical badges, or a repeated but non-actionable element. Fills use --accent; terracotta text (and any accent icon beside it) uses --accent-text, which clears AA on every ground including the sidebar's tonal step.

rules.name: The Case Signal Rule
rules.body: Mixed case is the default — headings included. Uppercase is reserved for the mono match-marker word and small utility/category labels. Never uppercase a sentence the user reads as prose, and never blanket-uppercase headings.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything that is data — a date, a count, a listing's fields, a match verdict — is set in --data-font. This is what carries at-a-glance scannability now that meta is text, not badges.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: A resting panel, board, row, or callout is distinguished by its surface tone and a hairline — never a shadow, never a side-stripe (a coloured left/right border). If an element needs to feel raised, step its tone up (--board/--surface), not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: Only overlays get --shadow-float, and it is one soft value for all of them. A hard offset shadow on a resting card is the banned pattern.

dos: Do keep the app one drenched sage ground; the sidebar is a tonal step of it, content sits directly on --ground, no floating sheet.
Do keep every hairline at --line; separate depth by tone, never by a shadow or a side-stripe.
Do render a listing as one --board panel with hairline-divided rows — not a grid of bordered cards.
Do set every data line in --data-font; meta is a mono middot line, match is a marker + --mark word, deadline is --deadline mono text.
Do spend terracotta on every real action/selection/deadline signal — including once per row in a list of identical actions; use --accent for fills and --accent-text for any terracotta text.
Do style in-content links as --ink with an underline; the underline is the affordance, not the colour. --accent-text is reserved for a link that is the view's next action.
Do keep controls pill-shaped and spacing roomy; copy and motion calm.
donts: Don't reintroduce cream, a dark wall, or a floating page sheet — the world is one sage ground.
Don't build cards: no per-item border + shadow, no soft card shadow on resting UI, no coloured side-stripe.
Don't stamp a row's own fields into pill badges; meta/status are text. Badge is only for categorical labels.

Don't paint an element terracotta by type (a rule like a { color: accent }) — every terracotta use still has to be a real action, selection, or deadline, not a blanket style; decorative or merely-repeated elements stay neutral.
Don't blanket-uppercase headings, or set a data line in the body sans.
Don't read as a generic SaaS dashboard, corporate job-board chrome, or an AI chat-bot persona.
Don't soften terracotta into a friendlier tint for primary actions — use the full value; softness lives in copy, motion, and the roomy form, not in desaturating the accent.
